correctness.rationale: The six regular differential forms give exact Cartier blocks A and B by exponent extraction. The semilinear Cartier-square matrix P=B^[5]A has determinant -2a^5(a^5-2a^2b^2-b). On H=0 its rank-one Frobenius iterate yields b=2a^47 and the 91 roots of squarefree R(a^7). Euclidean resultant and Groebner computations show all 91 are smooth and that the only smooth rank drop of A and B occurs at the origin. The genus-three divisor equation, smoothness, and intersection are explicit. Two independently constructed exact-arithmetic verifiers replay, including F5 and F25 census; finite replay corroborates algebraic arguments.

value.rationale: The natural p-rank stratification of genus-six cyclic trigonal curves is a motivated arithmetic invariant. The two-parameter subfamily has a structurally nontrivial reducible nonordinary divisor, a smooth genus-three component meeting a rank-zero line transversely, and a finite distinguished set of 91 genuine rank-zero specializations. It identifies the exact boundaries where Cartier rank and stable rank diverge, not a routine local computation or preexisting census.
